basic_profile.bio: I'm a 22-year-old college student majoring in Computer Science, currently living in the Twin Cities area. My interest in gaming, especially Minecraft, started during high school and has persisted through college. I enjoy exploring the technical aspects of games, but I often find myself frustrated with console limitations compared to PC capabilities. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after classes and during weekends. I'm single and often spend my free time playing games or watching gaming content on YouTube.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a moderate understanding of gaming, particularly in Minecraft and various console games. Most of my knowledge is self-taught through online communities, YouTube tutorials, and trial and error. I've recently begun exploring modding and game development as part of my coursework.
